question: What takes place in the Satya world under the self-born Brahma?
premises: The self-born Brahma dwells in the Satya world and manifests this universe.
The Vedas are present in that world.
Others refined by action and meditation also dwell there.
inference: Satya is the world of Brahma's cosmic manifestation and of beings perfected through Vedic action and meditation.
plain_english: There the self-born Brahma dwells and manifests this universe. In the Satya world are the Vedas and others who have been refined by action and meditation.
